blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Former Commission on Audit chairperson Gamaliel Cordoba is the newest Supreme Court associate justice.
He was the National Telecommunications Commission commissioner when former president Rodrigo Duterte launched a crackdown on ABS-CBN and Bulatlat.
A Rappler investigation also revealed that Cordoba is tied to a Mercidar Fishing Corporation, a big fishing company.
